messages:
Lina (CSM): Hey team, kicking off Meridian Labs pilot onboarding. Target: pilot live in 5-7 weeks. Need to map owners, define success metrics, and capture any early renewal risk flags.

Tom (Customer): Hi all 10 I'm Tom, PM on Meridian. Internal folks: Mira (SRE), Justin (Data), and Priya (Legal). We can provision test creds after the SOW is signed.

Ajay (Solutions Eng): I'll lead technical onboarding. Ask: sample request/response schema, auth flow, and whether they will use streaming.

Rosa (Success Ops): I'll make the enablement checklist and training slides. Also will track completion % per role.

Kyle (Product): Proposed acceptance criteria to start with: stable p90 latency <250ms, key intent F1 >=0.88 on their core eval set, and user satisfaction >=4.2/5 in pilot feedback.

Irene (Security): Quick security note: if Meridian insists on EU-only data, we need to plan Private deployment and a longer lead time for KMS. Please confirm data residency requirement ASAP.

Tom (Customer): We expect EU data controls but can scope for hybrid. I'll confirm legal constraints by Friday.

Ajay (Solutions Eng): Kickoff logistics: prefer Wed 9:30am PT for initial tech sync. Will prepare an integration template and a short smoke test script.

calendar-bot: Invite created: "Meridian Pilot: Tech Kickoff" Wed 9:30am PT - https://calendar.internal/evt/meridian-1

Lina (CSM): Draft timeline suggestion:
- Week 0: Kickoff + discovery
- Week 1: Access & initial smoke tests
- Week 2: Integration + basic evals
- Week 3: Enablement + internal dry-run
- Week 4: Pilot ramp + feedback capture
- Week 5: Iteration + health check
- Week 6: Final review & renewal signal review

Rosa (Success Ops): For enablement I need: top 30 user scenarios, 15 negative tests, and a short admin runbook from Meridian by end of Week 1.

Ajay (Solutions Eng): Sharing example smoke command to include in docs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-standard","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<sample>"}]}'
```

Kyle (Product): Also adding a regression eval to the pipeline. If quality drops >5% vs baseline after a change, auto-rollback to the previous model variant.

Lina (CSM): Renewal-risk triggers proposal: auto-escalate if by end of Week 4 active seats <40% of target OR weekly NPS <3.5. Escalation path: CSM -> AM -> Solutions Eng deep-dive.

Tom (Customer): Those triggers seem fair. We have an internal pilot champion (Mira) who will help drive adoption.

Irene (Security): I'll start a compliance checklist and flag anything needing legal signoff. Will reach out to Priya (Legal) at Meridian.

Rosa (Success Ops): I'll wire up a lightweight health dashboard: active sessions, avg latency, error rate, and adoption %. Will post link when available.

Ajay (Solutions Eng): Action items: I'll send invites, integration template, and the troubleshooting cheat-sheet (auth, CORS, payload mismatch).

Lina (CSM): Tom to confirm NDA/SOW signatures and provide schema. Team owners: Ajay = tech; Rosa = enablement; Kyle = quality targets; Irene = security signoff. I'll create the JIRA epic and share link here later today.

Tom (Customer): I'll push the SOW to Legal today. Thanks everyone.

Lina (CSM): Great. Next sync Fri with one-pager and the JIRA link. Thanks all :party_parrot:
